title: Fix some more encodings in calls
description:
Narrow a couple of fields to fit their usage instead of changing
encoding flag in call.

changes_data.diff:
@@ -958,7 +958,7 @@ proto_register_vsomeip(void) {

         { &hf_vsomeip_eventgroupid, { "Eventgroup ID", "vsomeip.eventgroup_id", FT_UINT16, BASE_HEX, NULL, 0x0, NULL, HFILL }},
